arm_report.eval_attention_source: transformers default, to match the anchor instrument
arm_report.reading: the tied embedding is frozen, so the output projection is frozen with it; every other text-tower identity is trained, and the deployed model reads the full text tower

correctness_and_likelihood.heldout: mean next-token CE and KL(teacher_T || student_T) on the held-out slice are reported by the companion held-out receipt
correctness_and_likelihood.sequence: the exact final-answer verdict from the S45 extractor on this task's own generations (gsm8k and minerva_math500)
correctness_and_likelihood.why_both: a lower mean CE can coexist with a lower exact-answer rate; neither quantity is substituted for the other

sequence_correctness.note: this verdict is the S45 exact extractor applied to the harness's own generations; it is reported beside, not instead of, the harness metric
sequence_correctness.reading: accuracy is over every item; accuracy_answered excludes ambiguous and unparseable completions. CE/KL are likelihood means and are reported beside this, never substituted for it.
